title: Strategy’s $100 STRC comeback could turn a cash drain into fresh Bitcoin buying power
summary: Strategy's STRC preferred stock briefly returned to $100 on Nov. 4, potentially restoring a funding channel for Bitcoin purchases after months of cash-consuming share buybacks.
